finding_info.title: DLP: bulk download from the Finance-Q1 SharePoint site by a contractor account
finding_info.desc:
Opened by: SOC Tier 1 (d.lindqvist) from DLP policy FIN-BULK-01.

Summary as reported: between 13:49 and 14:00 UTC the account ext_jmorris downloaded 1,840 files (2.3 GB) from the Finance-Q1 SharePoint site. ext_jmorris is a contractor account; the engagement end date on record is 2026-04-30.

Tier 1 triage notes:
- Site owner (finance-apps) notified, no reply yet on whether the download was requested.
- No external transfer observed so far; files landed on the contractor's managed laptop.

Requested of Tier 2: establish whether the download was authorized and whether any data left the managed device.

Work notes:
2026-04-20 14:05 UTC d.lindqvist — Incident created, assigned to SOC Tier 2.
